description: This file contains unit tests for the RegistrationClientImpl class in the org.eclipse.hono.client.impl package. It uses JUnit 5 and Mockito frameworks to verify behavior related to registration assertions, cache interactions, and message sending/response handling in the Eclipse Hono client library.

classes.name: RegistrationClientImplTest
classes.description: Test class verifying behavior of RegistrationClientImpl, including registration assertion, cache handling, message sending, and response processing.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixture with mocks and creates an instance of RegistrationClientImpl.

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationAddsResponseToCacheOnCacheMiss
methods.description: Verifies that on cache miss, the registration info is retrieved and cache is updated.

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationInvokesServiceIfNoCacheConfigured
methods.description: Verifies registration info retrieval from service if no cache is configured.

methods.name: testGetRegistrationInfoReturnsValueFromCache
methods.description: Ensures registration info is correctly returned from cache.

methods.name: testGetRegistrationInfoIncludesRequiredParamsInRequest
methods.description: Checks that request messages include device ID and gateway ID.
